d:
A man is kidnapped.
Charles, an aging dentist, has kidnapped Martin, a younger bartender. Martin has slept with Charles's wife, and an enraged Charles intends to harm Martin as his wife watches.
As Charles berates Martin into the truth, the two men find themselves drawn into a more searching, philosophical direction -- one that is brutally honest about what happened and why, and about how they may be more similar than different.
